item.title: StageNeth
item.description:
Overview

Router OS designed for live performance environments, based on OpenWrt. StageNeth separates audio/video/lighting (AV) streams from the management network and provides the services stage equipment relies on: DHCP, NTP, mDNS, SNMP and PTP.

Features

  • Vue 3 web UI over HTTPS — simple mode (operator) and expert mode (tech)
  • Secured Go API (HttpOnly sessions, argon2id passwords, operator/tech roles)
  • Go network orchestrator — automatic generation of 802.1q VLANs, bridges, firewall, DHCP, QoS/NIC tuning and PTP
  • Per-service configuration — each protocol (Dante, NDI, AES67/RAVENNA, ST 2110, Art-Net, sACN, PTP, AVB, NMOS, MA-Net…) gets its own VLAN, DSCP, priority and MTU
  • Configurable AV trunk and dedicated ST 2110 interface with jumbo frames (MTU 9000)
  • NTP server with DHCP option 42 per VLAN, mDNS reflector across AV VLANs
  • Monitoring: CPU/memory/services, alerts, filterable logs, SNMP v2c/v3 agent, Prometheus metrics

Status

🚧 Active development (v0.2.0-beta) — validate on the bench before any production use.

Links

  • GitHub repository
  • Languages: Go, Vue 3, OpenWrt

item.title: aes67_visualizer
item.description:
Overview

Cross-platform desktop application for visualizing and monitoring audio-over-IP streams: AES67, ST2110-30, RAVENNA and Dante. Automatic stream discovery on the network, playback, level metering and PTP tracking.

Features

  • Automatic stream discovery via SAP/mDNS
  • Manual stream entry by pasting SDP
  • Direct Dante device queries via ARC (name, model, TX/RX channels)
  • 16-slot monitoring wall with drag-and-drop
  • Real-time dBFS metering with peak hold
  • Listen to any stream with channel selection
  • PTP tracking (IEEE 1588 grandmaster, per-stream lock status)
  • UI in 8 languages
  • Windows, macOS, Linux

Tech stack

React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + TailwindCSS, Electron desktop shell, audio via Audify (RtAudio bindings).

  • GitHub repository

item.title: ptp-monitor
item.description:
Overview

Desktop tool (Qt / PySide6) for passively listening to PTP clock traffic on a production audio-over-IP network — to detect problems and record evidence for vendor support cases.

100% passive: it joins the standard PTP multicast group 224.0.1.129 (UDP 319/320) and listens. It never sends a single PTP packet and cannot disturb the clock election or timing of the network.

Features

  • Dante leader (PTPv1) — who sends Sync, sync interval, jitter (mean/min/max/σ), leader change history
  • AES67 grandmaster (PTPv2) — clock identity, priorities, clock class, steps removed, announce timing
  • Per-source stats — message types, rates, sequence gaps/dupes, silence detection, non-standard PTP domains
  • Malformed packets — unparsable datagrams logged with source IP and full hexdump
  • Evidence logs — chronological JSONL journal + optional full packet capture
  • Network-agnostic — no hard-coded addresses; friendly device names via devices.json, reverse DNS and the IEEE OUI database

Links

  • GitHub repository
  • Language: Python (Qt / PySide6)

The UI is currently in French — i18n contributions are welcome.
